name: Belmont Science and Mathematics Summer Camps
org: Belmont University College of Sciences and Mathematics
what_you_do: Join a camp taught by Belmont professors. Camps last one week or more. Topics in 2026 included game design. Others were forensic chemistry, AI and astronomy.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 and older for the 2026 camps. The RISE research camps also need a 3.0 overall GPA and a 3.0 math and science GPA.
pay_detail: Most 2026 camps cost $425. The RISE research camps cost $1,700. One camp, VISIBL, was $0 for Metro Nashville students nominated by a science teacher. Email Beth Bowman if cost is a problem.
duration: One-week camps. RISE ran about four weeks.
deadline_text: Registration for 2027 opens in December 2026. The 2026 camps ran June 8 to July 17.
how_to_apply: Sign up for the newsletter on the camp page to hear when registration opens. Then register for the camp you want.
notes: Camps for 2027 may differ from the 2026 list. The page asks you to email Beth Bowman at beth.bowman@belmont.edu with questions.
